original.target_description: Nahmias, Coates & Kvaran (2007), study with eight scenarios: printed p.228 (PDF15) contains five mechanism main effects, five universe main effects, five interactions, and Real/Ertan pairwise t-tests. Supplied study 1 and p.15 do not distinguish one outcome and test.

notes: Published 2007 source verified and PDF15 rendered/inspected. Cannot assign these five audit IDs to particular outcomes or tests from source order or blank descriptions. Even audit1087 describes both free will and moral responsibility, with multiple relevant tests. No audit-ID ordering assumed. Overall retained sample632 is not the analytic n for each printed test. Need neutral effect-specific outcome and contrast locators; paper is available.
